title: Mobile page among cacti
slide_intent: Keep the message readable within a vivid setting because photography should support rather than obscure an interface.
strategic_value: The pale green page and black illustration can connect Mailchimp’s digital offer to an organic photographic world.
demonstration: A white phone stands among cacti, displaying a customer-conversation headline, illustration and compact navigation.
practical_value: Compare interface contrast against a detailed photographic background.

content_islands.name: Phone
content_islands.spec: Place the readable vertical phone near center among the cactus stems.

content_islands.name: Page
content_islands.spec: Retain the green headline region, small controls and line illustration inside the phone.

content_islands.name: Setting
content_islands.spec: Use the surrounding plants and blue sky as context rather than page content.

reference_purposes.Application: The source places a branded mobile page in a photographic scene.
